node.name: footer · data statement
node.chars: Data: synthetic only — a seeded BTCUSDT (seed 574) 1m series of 800 bars to the forming bar 14:05 UTC; tick and qty step from the recorded instrument fixture; volumes, deltas, trades, prices, the thresholds' example bounds and the viewing-as user "Manager 01" are synthetic. No account data, key or balance. C-2.11 (R-1): the strip reads the live public trade stream on demo and live alike; no DEMO / LIVE badge and no environment control appears; nothing on this board differs by environment.

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Theme: dark (exported as docs/design/E20/img/E20-D02-02-compact-and-collapse.png); §0 L60: 10 boards, 0 light twins — the light and high-contrast renders are not drawn, the text is binding; every fill here is a neutral token, so the T2 and breach grammar holds under any theme switch

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Greyscale, desktop, 1280 × 800 windows (§0): a wireframe — colour, type, iconography and elevation are E20-D03's

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: The user's row-set choice in SCR-033 (14:865), never the automatic collapse (§4): the default's first three in order, each with its PROPOSED short label and its §7 label as its accessible name (MEMO A6)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Compact mode does not change how a cell renders; on narrow bars a compact strip still collapses (§4.1)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: §9 L326 Delta: live footprint + trades; bootstrap /market/footprint; history /market/metrics delta (22:19151)

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: §9 L329 Delta %: live footprint + trades; bootstrap /market/footprint; history D02-G1

kids.name: value-6
kids.chars: §9 L322 Total Volume: live footprint + trades; bootstrap /market/footprint; history D02-G1

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Below the minimum legible bar width (40 px here: E20-K01's number, seeded from E18-D02:124, MEMO G5) each cell drops its digits and keeps its row class's glyph: ▲ / ▼ signed, · (PROPOSED) unsigned, the breach-glyph slot added on a breached cell; row labels stay; nothing clipped

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Each cell's accessible text keeps the full value, its unit and the sign word (W-5)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Performance (§4.3, D02-C2): the 12-row ceiling; both budgets recorded — "<=1.5 ms per frame" (14:874) and "strip adds ≤2 ms per frame" (11:1885)

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Recomputed on bar close and on the visible-range change (14:874); the forming bar coalesced to 4 Hz (15:2936; MEMO C6, E20-T02)
